scope: Re-establish PASS 4 on the current production repository baseline, preserve the accepted Scientific Base macro-architecture, reconcile the scientific/publication authority stack, and authorize the next content-population stage without production rendering changes.

work_branch.rule: Fresh branch from current main. The stale PASS 4 branch is retained as historical lineage and is not rebased into production.

historical_pass4_lineage.reason_not_continued_directly: Repository main advanced materially after the original PASS 4 start. Continuing the old branch directly would create avoidable baseline/reconciliation risk.
historical_pass4_lineage.recovery_method: Exact latest file blobs were re-materialized onto the fresh current-main branch. No stale production files were copied.

authority_precedence.rule: Frozen/controlled module, construct, scoring, validation, safety and privacy authorities govern scientific substance and cannot be altered by WEB-SCIENCE.
EXT-SYS ownership, redundancy, discriminant and information-gain authorities govern cross-module distinctions and research-only bridge eligibility.
WEB-SCIENCE PASS 1/2 and the production registry govern information architecture, publication states, routing and renderer boundaries; they do not create scientific status.

The governing Scientific Base positioning may explain P-120 as an authorial integration research system grounded in external science and internally verified architecture, but it may not upgrade empirical or psychometric status.
Terminology, documentation and publication authorities control wording, localization, traceability and presentation; they remain subordinate to scientific/measurement authority.

governing_scientific_positioning.external_scientific_foundation: Published scientific literature, empirical studies, existing research constructs and measurement precedents are the external evidence foundation.
governing_scientific_positioning.p120_internal_architecture: P-120 separately records its own construct selection, construct-boundary, ownership, redundancy, item-level, information-gain, scope/exposure, computational-contract and cross-module verification work.
governing_scientific_positioning.integration_principle: Independent psychological processes remain independently measured and are joined only after measurement when an authorized cross-layer interpretation exists.
governing_scientific_positioning.validation_boundary: Internal scientific-methodological, computational and cross-module verification is evidence about development and architecture; it is not empirical psychometric validation on respondent samples.
governing_scientific_positioning.extended_rule: A new module is retained only when it addresses an independent measurement question and has a plausible path to incremental information beyond neighboring layers.
governing_scientific_positioning.dyadic_rule: Profile A and Profile B remain independently measured before a separate dyadic layer; no universal compatibility percentage is authorized without its own empirically supported dyadic model.
